description:

Aaron

Very likely he wants to come back next Spring/Summer - really appreciate the energy you all put in to the kids, he's had a great time with Ignite.

Esther

Please read the important notes below to help prepare for your class: To prep for our in-studio classes: For Yoga : Bring your own mat ($3 mat rental fee if you don't bring your own mat), towel (mainly for heated classes, we don't offer them at the studio) and water bottle (we have water fountains available to use at the studio).
